rationale: The plan nails the design: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time with time as a 4-level factor, explicit reference levels, no spurious batch term, per-time-point Wald contrasts built from the same fit with apeglm/ashr shrinkage, and an honest 16-residual-df power statement. QC is thorough (PCA, distances, library sizes, coloured by design factors) with a flag-don't-drop outlier stance, and enrichment uses the tested-gene universe, named human collections, a size floor and a stated GSEA ranking metric, though no collection version. Weaknesses: the low-count filter rule is never specified in the plan itself (only deferred to the step report), normalization inside the model is never stated even though the count-state ambiguity is handled well, the |LFC|>1 timing classification is a post hoc threshold rather than an lfcThreshold in the test, and software versions are not requested in the report.
